# ADR 0004: Deny with 403 and record every decision in an append-only access log

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Secure open banking accounts API

## Context

Regulators and customers need to know who accessed what and when; probing must not reveal data.

## Decision

Write an access_log row for each allowed or denied request in the same transaction as the read; responses for accounts outside the consent are 403 without saying whether the account exists.

## Consequences

Complete audit trail and no existence leaks. Log volume grows with traffic (partition by month later).

## Alternatives considered

Application logs only (not queryable, easy to lose).
